mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 8.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to labor market weakening and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 indicates tightening monetary policy and strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (high CPIAUCSL and GDPC1), positive S&P 500 returns occur over the next 20 trading days as market anticipates sustained growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 700 indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite HOUST > 700.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in PAYEMS below 130,000 signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative despite PAYEMS falling below 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (demand) alongside INDPRO (supply) suggests expansionary demand and constrained supply, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery (improving UNRATE and INDPRO), positive S&P 500 returns occur over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in post-recession recovery periods.
